recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed; do not reintroduce or locally restate the removed CodeSystem unless a future PA/terminology decision changes the Patient marital-status terminology design.
issue_request: FHIR-16516 was Published/Persuasive and asked why the normative-ballot CodeSystem http://hl7.org/fhir/marital-status existed when it said it was not used and the Marital Status ValueSet used v3 MaritalStatus plus NullFlavor instead; the resolution was to remove the redundant unused CodeSystem.
initial_application: No commit mentioning FHIR-16516 was found. The same source change was applied under primary tracker FHIR-16319 by commit 6fc4d35729, which deleted source/terminologies/codesystem-marital-status.xml; FHIR-16516 Jira comments then state that the code system was removed.
additional_context: FHIR-16516 explicitly names FHIR-16319 and FHIR-16616 as related duplicate-family issues. FHIR-16319 is the primary Published/Persuasive removal issue, while FHIR-16616 was closed as Duplicate. July 2018 Zulip PA discussion likewise records that codesystem-marital-status was no longer needed and should be removed.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source has no codesystem-marital-status file, no active fhir.ini CodeSystem entry for marital-status, and no current source reference to the obsolete canonical http://hl7.org/fhir/marital-status.
